verdict.rationale: Tailscale provides a stable mesh IP so SSH connections can be re-established quickly after network changes (docs and user testimonials mention seamless SSH access), but there is no direct evidence that an active terminal session itself survives sleep/network switches — that depends on the SSH client, not Tailscale's core function. Community reports also cite reconnection issues (DERP fallback, carrier blocking) that undercut a strong 'always alive' claim.
